units.rhetorical_move: a list of harms is blamed on one missing understanding

units.reusable_pattern: pick one legitimate reason out of a list of harms

units.reusable_pattern: state the significance as a chain of purposes

prohibited_generalizations: do not reuse the purposes

units.rhetorical_move: a result is said to show the model is effective for different scales
